Backend: all 33 pytest tests pass in 31s — 27 regression (health/auth/catalog/courses/enrollment/quiz/cert/dashboard/AI tutor SSE) + 6 NEW intelligence tests (public briefing schema, cache behavior with from_cache:true + cache_age_hours, force flag, auth-gated course refresh, unknown-slug 404, refresh schema with freshness_score/gaps/new_lessons_suggested/deprecations/executive_note). Briefing endpoint returned cached response in ~170ms (already generated). Cached briefing has 8 signals + 8 course refresh priorities. Frontend: full ITHR rebrand verified — ITHR logo in header (10x10 dark chip), 'BY ITHR TECHNOLOGIES' subtitle, 'AN ITHR TECHNOLOGIES VALUE PROPOSITION' hero overline, teal brand color computed as rgb(0,168,151) = #00A896, new hero CTA 'See today's intelligence' routes to /intelligence, dark-navy 'Curriculum that refreshes itself' section visible. minor.issue: No schema validation on LLM output before caching — if Claude ever returns malformed JSON without markdown fences the endpoint returns 502; but stale cache is served correctly as fallback. Consider Pydantic model to normalize.
First-call latency depends on LLM (~15-25s). No timeout guard; a client abort mid-flight will not be detected server-side. Cache TTL is 12h which is fine.

issues: 'Most popular' badge on Practitioner uses class 'badge-crimson' — legacy naming after teal rebrand; class still renders correctly but rename to 'badge-brand' for palette consistency.
Same legacy 'badge-crimson' class on 'Recommended' badge for Enterprise tier.

action_items: LOW: Rename CSS class .badge-crimson → .badge-brand (Pricing.jsx uses it in two places) to match the new teal palette naming.
LOW: Consider a Pydantic model for the intelligence briefing JSON to validate LLM output structure before caching.

INFO (from iteration 1, still applicable): server.py now ~660 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting intelligence routes into a separate router module in the next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.py uses datetime_now_hash() as session_id salt (hourly bucket). This means concurrent briefing generations within the same hour share a session_id — for emergentintegrations LlmChat this is safe (server-tracked) but not ideal; consider uuid4 for briefing regeneration to avoid session-history collisions.

server.py:_extract_json() strips '```' but does not defensively handle nested backticks or partial JSON; a malformed model output crashes with json.JSONDecodeError which is caught but yields a 502. Acceptable for now.

Intelligence briefing endpoint is fully public and unauthenticated — a scraper could hammer it. Since cache is 6h it's low-cost, but consider a light rate limit (e.g., 30 req/min per IP) before production.

Landing.jsx hero has hardcoded static 'sample' intelligence signals (Anthropic Claude 4.6, MCP 2.0, EU AI Act). If these values drift out of sync with what the live briefing shows, it may confuse marketing. Consider fetching /api/intelligence/briefing with .signals.slice(0,3) instead of hardcoded copy.
AITutorPanel: shadow color still uses rgba(163,22,33,...) (crimson red) after the teal rebrand — cosmetic only but inconsistent with the new palette.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per pytest session (test.learner+<ts>@example.com / TestPass123!). No pre-seeded accounts.
